knobs.name: caseT0
knobs.what: s: film time at which the agents' stack-city clock starts (CASE t0)

knobs.name: caseDur
knobs.what: s: length of the agents' clock; beats below are converted to fractions of it

knobs.name: arrive0
knobs.what: s: the first agent's box drops onto the floor

knobs.name: arrive1
knobs.what: s: the last box is down; must be <= 22.0 so 5,179 is landed before any ratio

knobs.name: lit0
knobs.what: s: the gaining boxes start to light, bottom-up (after the count has landed)

knobs.name: lit1
knobs.what: s: every gaining box is lit; the pooled +14 % pin follows at poolPin

knobs.name: poolPin
knobs.what: s: the pooled pin (the average) appears, a ratio after the count

knobs.name: poolOut
knobs.what: s: the pooled pin leaves before the re-sort (labels cut off at move start)

knobs.name: zone0
knobs.what: s: the three skill zones start to be outlined on the floor

knobs.name: zone1
knobs.what: s: the zone outlines are drawn

knobs.name: move0
knobs.what: s: the boxes leave the pooled column for their skill zone (keep equal to the camera's m1 t0)

knobs.name: move1
knobs.what: s: the last box is in its zone (keep equal to the camera's m1 t1)

knobs.name: tag0
knobs.what: s: the followed agent takes the accent (outline, trail, ghost of its old home)

knobs.name: tag1
knobs.what: s: the followed agent returns to the crowd

knobs.name: tagPin1
knobs.what: s: the riding pin 'ONE AGENT' leaves after the move

knobs.name: tagPin2
knobs.what: s: the pin returns at the close-up (after the look-at settles)

knobs.name: tagPin3
knobs.what: s: the pin leaves before the pull-back lands

knobs.name: namePins
knobs.what: s: the three zones are named (and the zone count), after the settle

knobs.name: noviceAt
knobs.what: s: the lowest-skill zone's result lands (hold 3.0 s)

knobs.name: expertAt
knobs.what: s: the highest-skill zone's result lands (hold >= 3.0 s)

knobs.name: avg0
knobs.what: s: the average returns as a dashed line across the three zones

knobs.name: avgOut
knobs.what: s: the average line and the zone pins leave before the close-up

knobs.name: zoneOut
knobs.what: s: the zone pins leave (cut off before the look-at at 60 s)

knobs.name: backT0
knobs.what: s: the pull-back to the stored wide split pose starts (T8: lands on the m1 pose)

knobs.name: backT1
knobs.what: s: the pull-back lands

knobs.name: legendAt
knobs.what: s: the legend 'ONE BOX = ONE AGENT' lands on the wide split

knobs.name: names2
knobs.what: s: the zone names return on the wide split (no digits)

knobs.name: ledgerOut
knobs.what: s: the agents ledger leaves before the move

knobs.name: dvT0
knobs.what: s: hard cut to the developers' field (keep equal to the camera's m4 t0)

knobs.name: dvArrive0
knobs.what: s: the first developer's box drops

knobs.name: dvArrive1
knobs.what: s: the last box is down; 4,867 lands at 84.0

knobs.name: dvLit0
knobs.what: s: the gaining boxes start to light

knobs.name: dvLit1
knobs.what: s: every gaining box is lit

knobs.name: dvPin
knobs.what: s: the pooled +26 % pin appears (4.0 s after the count)

knobs.name: dvPinOut
knobs.what: s: the pin leaves before the descent

knobs.name: mrT0
knobs.what: s: hard cut to the METR desk (keep equal to the camera's m5b t0)

knobs.name: dotsAt
knobs.what: s: the 16 developer dots start to count in

knobs.name: dotsEnd
knobs.what: s: the 16th dot is down

knobs.name: pin16
knobs.what: s: the pin '16' lands (hold 3.0 s)

knobs.name: boxes0
knobs.what: s: the first issue column drops onto the desk

knobs.name: boxes1
knobs.what: s: the 246th column is down

knobs.name: pin246
knobs.what: s: the pin '246' lands (hold 6.0 s)

knobs.name: ghostAt
knobs.what: s: the forecast ghost block, the baseline loops and the legend appear (the belief view)

knobs.name: pin24Out
knobs.what: s: the '24 %' pin leaves before the tilt

knobs.name: pinSlower
knobs.what: s: the pin '19 %' lands on the measured block (hold 3.0 s)

knobs.name: pinBelieved
knobs.what: s: the pin '20 %' lands on the ghost, with the believed-after ring

knobs.name: bookAt
knobs.what: s: the bookend cut back to the pooled floor (keep equal to the camera's m7 t0)

knobs.name: bookPhase
knobs.what: s: which moment of the agents' clock the bookend shows (pooled, every gaining box lit)

knobs.name: honest0
knobs.what: s: the honest-limits line appears on stage

knobs.name: honestOut
knobs.what: s: the honest-limits line leaves before the card

knobs.name: hookRise0
knobs.what: s: the pooled outline starts to rise (the belief)

knobs.name: hookRise1
knobs.what: s: the outline has risen

knobs.name: hookOut
knobs.what: s: the outline and its label leave as the first agents drop

knobs.name: loneAt
knobs.what: s: the lone box drops onto the empty floor

knobs.name: boxSize
knobs.what: world units: edge of one agent's or developer's box

knobs.name: boxGap
knobs.what: world units: seam between boxes

knobs.name: poolLayers
knobs.what: boxes high the agents' pooled column is (rate form: footprint = how many, lit height = gain)

knobs.name: poolDepth
knobs.what: boxes deep the agents' pooled column is

knobs.name: slabLayers
knobs.what: boxes high a skill zone is (rate form: every zone about as tall, lit height = gain)

knobs.name: slabDepth
knobs.what: boxes deep a skill zone is

knobs.name: slabGap
knobs.what: world units: aisle between the skill zones

knobs.name: dvLayers
knobs.what: boxes high the developers' pooled column is

knobs.name: dvDepth
knobs.what: boxes deep the developers' pooled column is

knobs.name: mrSize
knobs.what: world units: edge of one issue column on the METR desk

knobs.name: mrGap
knobs.what: world units: seam between issue columns

knobs.name: mrGapX
knobs.what: world units: gap between the ghost block and the measured block

knobs.name: baseH
knobs.what: world units: the baseline height (time without AI); forecast, believed and measured heights scale from it

knobs.name: deskW
knobs.what: world units: desk width

knobs.name: deskD
knobs.what: world units: desk depth

knobs.name: dotR
knobs.what: world units: radius of one developer dot

knobs.name: dotPitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the 16 developer dots

knobs.name: dotGap
knobs.what: world units: how far in front of the blocks the dot row stands

knobs.name: hookH
knobs.what: world units: height the belief outline rises to (about the lit pooled height)

knobs.name: loneGap
knobs.what: boxes: how far left of the pooled footprint the lone box stands

knobs.name: gainFull
knobs.what: percent gain that fills a whole column (drawing scale only; lit height = gain / this)

knobs.name: tagLayer
knobs.what: layer of the followed agent's box in its zone (a box on an outside face is chosen near it)

knobs.name: drop
knobs.what: world units a box falls from as it arrives

knobs.name: arrW
knobs.what: fraction of the arrival window one box takes to fall and grow

knobs.name: stagger
knobs.what: 0-0.25: how spread out in time the boxes leave (each keeps its own path)

knobs.name: lift
knobs.what: world units: height of the arc each box makes between its two homes

knobs.name: orderMix
knobs.what: 0 = seeded order, 1 = zone order (the zones fill one after another)

knobs.name: ambient
knobs.what: fill light on every face

knobs.name: keyLight
knobs.what: key light from above-left on top and side faces

knobs.name: dim
knobs.what: 0-1: how far a box with no gain is mixed toward the floor (larger = darker)

knobs.name: floorMix
knobs.what: 0-1: floor colour from ground (0) to panel (1)

knobs.name: gridMix
knobs.what: 0-1: floor grid line colour from ground toward muted

knobs.name: zoneMix
knobs.what: 0-1: zone outline colour from ground toward amber

knobs.name: deskMix
knobs.what: 0-1: desk colour from the floor panel toward muted

knobs.name: floorW
knobs.what: world units: floor width

knobs.name: floorD
knobs.what: world units: floor depth

knobs.name: gridStep
knobs.what: world units: floor grid spacing

knobs.name: swayAmp
knobs.what: degrees: amplitude of the calm sway about the aim point, the whole film (0 = still)

knobs.name: swayPeriod
knobs.what: s: period of the sway (longer = slower; <= 1 degree/s under a number)

knobs.name: hold
knobs.what: frames a label must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels hysteresis)

knobs.name: leader
knobs.what: sheet units: leader length of a pin

knobs.name: maxShown
knobs.what: label budget per frame (R7: <= 6 near a move)

knobs.name: pinLift
knobs.what: world units: a pin's anchor above its mark

knobs.name: resultSize
knobs.what: sheet units: result pins (floor 28)

knobs.name: hookSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the 'AI' label on the belief outline

knobs.name: ledgerSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the counted-in number in the ledger (must-read)

knobs.name: honestSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the honest-limits line on stage (secondary)

knobs.name: honestY
knobs.what: sheet y of the honest-limits line (keep above the caption band, y < 420)

knobs.name: plate
knobs.what: 0-1: opacity of the dark plate behind a pin

knobs.name: dispAdv
knobs.what: em: average advance of the display face, for label boxes
